rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WEKdereroro
Exhibition name: Neil Diamond
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 2011).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2015.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, white stripes. Strong, sweet fragrance. 40 to 50 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, spreading, well-branched. Glossy, dark green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 6¼' to 8'1" (190 to 245cm). Width: 6¼' to 7'1" (190 to 215cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 4b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot .
